Name: Stardew Valley Pokemon Gym
Author: TheHornedWolf
Description:
Changes your house into a pokemon gym reminiscent of the classic pokemon gym style, which still retaining some Stardew Valley aesthetic.

Currently, the same graphics are being used for tiers 1-3 for the houses, so they all look the same. In my free time, I do plan on going and changing two of the tiers to make them have a distinct look.

Remember to backup your files!

Downloads.Description: Changes your house into a pokemon gym-styled building.
